verdict: Simon's rent machine grew revenue 13% and Real Estate FFO per share rose 5% to $3.37, but GAAP profit fell to $499M on $130M of non-cash mark-to-market losses.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: total revenue $1,815M (rounded) vs $1,602M a year ago

kpis.label: FFO per share
kpis.note: vs $3.25 a year ago, incl. $0.27 of non-cash losses

segments.name: Lease income
segments.note: Rent from retailers at malls and Premium Outlets — up 16%, with occupancy at 96.5% and base rent per square foot up 6.1%.

segments.name: Management fees & other revenues
segments.note: Fees for managing properties for partners and other revenues — up 25%.

segments.name: Other income (revenue)
segments.note: Other property-level income reported in revenue — down from $112M a year ago.

opex.name: Depreciation & amortization
opex.note: Non-cash cost of malls and outlets wearing out — the largest expense, up sharply year over year.

opex.name: Real estate taxes
opex.note: Property taxes on the mall portfolio.

opex.name: Other operating costs
opex.note: Repairs and maintenance ($32M), advertising and promotion ($36M), home and regional office costs ($70M) and other costs ($43M).

opex.name: SG&A
opex.note: General and administrative costs as reported (a narrow line in Simon's statement).

takeaways.title: The malls themselves are thriving
takeaways.text: Portfolio net operating income rose 6.7%, occupancy hit 96.5%, base rent per foot rose 6.1% and retailer sales per foot jumped 14.8% to $852. Simon raised full-year Real Estate FFO guidance again.

takeaways.title: Paper losses cut GAAP profit
takeaways.text: Unrealized mark-to-market losses of $130M — on Klépierre exchangeable bonds and a newly public equity holding — cut net income to $499M from $606M, a $99.6M after-tax drag of $0.27 per share.

takeaways.title: Dividend raised
takeaways.text: The quarterly dividend rises to $2.30 per share, up 4.5% year over year, payable December 31. Simon also bought back $237M of stock in the quarter.

oneTimers: $129.6M of unrealized mark-to-market losses on publicly traded equity instruments and derivatives (Klépierre exchangeable bonds and a revalued equity security) — $99.6M after tax, or $0.27 per share.
otherDetail: Other income of -$262M is interest expense of $288M and an $8M loss on disposal/revaluation of equity interests, partly offset by $153M of income from unconsolidated entities and an $11M gain on acquisitions, sales and recoveries. The $23M tax benefit is shown separately.
footerNote: Consolidated net income was $565M; after $66M for noncontrolling interests (mainly Operating Partnership unitholders) and preferred dividends, $499M was attributable to common stockholders. Totals use $1,814M of revenue (statement: $1,814.6M) so the rounded pieces sum exactly.
